scope: Real daily launcher, renderer, read-only budget/memory/assessment services, required composition and normal shutdown; not all-plugin runtime certification.
privateStateInterpretation: Includes directories and absent markers; not a file count. Original byte hashes checked locally; no paths, bodies or hashes exported.
cleanupPath: Normal Electron app.quit and managed launcher/host close; no forced cleanup.

compatibility.interpretation: Inventory counts do not establish per-plugin runtime compatibility or defect counts.
